data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 紧急阶梯下的秘密耳语
data.description: 放学后昏暗寂静的紧急阶梯拐角，轻井泽惠四下张望确认无人后，轻轻拉住你的校服衣袖。少女脸颊泛着绯红，亮蓝色的双眸闪烁着既紧张又甜美的笑意，附在耳畔轻声低语今晚的秘密约会。
data.location: secluded emergency school stairwell landing with sun streaming through tall window
data.action: tucked away in a quiet stairwell corner, peeking out nervously while tugging partner sleeve, whispering with flushed cheeks and sparkling eyes
data.lighting: warm afternoon dust motes floating in sunbeams
data.mood: thrilling clandestine romance, sweet conspiratorial intimacy, school secret lovers
data.promptProse: In a quiet school stairwell corner, Kei Karuizawa tugs partner sleeve with flushed cheeks, whispering secret lover plans with sparkling blue eyes.
